title: How many places does 100 move the point?
text: 100 has two zeros, so multiplying by 100 moves the decimal point two places to the right. A common mistake is to move it one place, or to move it left as if you were dividing. How many places does the decimal point move?

title: Move the point in 0.08
text: Start at $$0.08$$ and move the decimal point two places right. The digits 0 and 8 become a whole number. What whole number do you land on?

title: Worked solution
text: $$0.08 \times 100 = 8$$. The point jumps over both digits. Common mistake: answering $$0.8$$ or $$800$$. General rule: multiplying by $$10^{n}$$ moves the decimal point $$n$$ places to the right. Dividing by $$10^{n}$$ moves it $$n$$ places to the left.
